ache.title: Machamp EX: four arms, one chase card
ache.note: His favourite Machamp EX deck: the Machop line, Diglett and Dugtrio, Old Amber and Aerodactyl. Having a favourite deck is the good part. The catch is that an EX at the core can mean opening pack after pack to find it, and the moment a deck needs ‘one more card’ is where the spending begins.
watch: an EX card as the deck’s core
ache.tip: Build with what you’ve pulled for free. If the deck is missing a card, swap in one you own.
lines: four arms and still can’t hold a budget
one more card is never just one
